name: ModelVariant790_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant790_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (every period a spinning star leaves a model part and flies to a jittered point before the opposing slot, drawing a fading red, green and blue ribbon behind it; on arrival it bounces back, glows and throws animated sparks while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the stars and packs two texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start time, 4 once the first star has bounced, 1 once after the end time when the last star has bounced, 2 once the last glow has faded after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-807 and 904 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
